name: Hanam Data Center
developer: IGIS Asset Management / Macquarie Korea Infrastructure Fund; LG CNS tenant/operator
notes: MKIF asset page lists Pungsan-dong, Hanam-si location, 28 Nov 2023 completion, 40MW total capacity, 25.44MW target IT load, Tier 3/hyperscale scale, and LG CNS as main tenant.

name: IBK Hanam Data Center
developer: Industrial Bank of Korea / SAMOO Architects & Engineers
notes: SAMOO project page identifies an IBK Hanam Data Center in Hanam-si, Gyeonggi-do, with 50,233 sqm area, data hall and operations building, and 2024 project completion; electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: BARO AI Hanam Data Center
notes: Invest Korea/Jeju investment notice says BARO AI would establish a second data center in Jeju following its Hanam data center; BARO AI site lists its Hanam Techno Valley address. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Samsung SDS Dongtan Data Center / Samsung HPC Center
notes: Samsung SDS announced Korea's first HPC-dedicated Dongtan data center in Hwaseong/Dongtan; Samsung Semiconductor describes the Hwaseong HPC Center as Korea's largest data center with 114MW electric capacity and 116,000 servers.

name: Kakao Namyangju Digital Hub Data Center
notes: Kakao says it signed an MOU for a second data center in Namyangju; trade press reports KRW 600bn investment, 92,000 sqm site in Wangsuk Urban Advanced Industrial Complex, construction planned for 2026 and completion targeted for 2029. Capacity not disclosed in primary source.

name: Korea Digital Valley Namyangju AI Data Center Campus
developer: Korea Digital Valley / Hidden Holdings / Nemo Partners
notes: Korea Digital Valley project page describes a Namyangju project approximately 30 minutes from central Seoul with planned capacity up to 1,200MW across a 720,000 sqm site for hyperscale and AI workloads; page metadata shows original publication on 2025-12-30.

name: LG Uplus Paju AI Data Center
notes: DCD reports LG Uplus will invest KRW 615.6bn in a Paju, Gyeonggi Province AI data center on former LG Display real estate, with completion set for 2027 and more than 100,000 servers; public power capacity not disclosed by company in cited article.

name: Pocheon Traon AI Data Center
notes: Asia Business Daily reports Pocheon City signed an MOU with Traon on 2025-12-08; Traon had completed procedures and secured KEPCO approval to use 100MW of electricity.

name: GN B Data Center Sinbuk-myeon
developer: GN B Data Center Co., Ltd.
notes: Asia Business Daily reports Pocheon City signed an MOA with GN B Data Center for construction and operation of a data center in Sinbuk-myeon, with construction set to begin in first half 2026; capacity not disclosed.

name: BARO Space Pyeongtaek Hybrid AI Computing Center
notes: Asia Business Daily reports BARO AI opened BARO Space in Pyeongtaek on 2025-10-29, a liquid-cooled modular AI computing center with standardized GPU cell units up to 400 GPUs per cell; facility MW capacity not disclosed.

name: SK Broadband CDC Pangyo
notes: DCD reports SK C&C sold its 30MW Pangyo data center business to SK Broadband; Data Center Knowledge locates SK C&C's data center in Pangyo Techno Valley, Seongnam-si.

name: Bundang Hostway IDC
notes: IGIS Value Plus REIT property page identifies Bundang Hostway IDC as a Tier 3 data center with total 12.5MW capacity and dual power receiving facilities from Yatap and Bundang substations.

name: Kakao Seoul National University Siheung Campus Data Center
notes: Kakao's planned second data center at Seoul National University Siheung Campus was cancelled after discussions with SNU; earlier reports described a 100MW project planned to start construction in 2024 and complete in 2026.

name: AIDC Shin-Geumcheon Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists AIDC Shin-Geumcheon Data Center at Suin-ro, Siheung-si, Gyeonggi-do and shows AIDC has one data center in Siheung-si; capacity not disclosed and source is aggregate.
